title: super awful garland
text: super awful garland. This was the saddest, ugliest garland in person - it really looked like garbage.  I couldn't possibly use it.  I just tossed it.  If you're going for total shabby chic - you'd have to step up on this one.  Yikes. The pine boughs are frayed at the end - which really adds to garbage look.  I feel bad - maybe this would be perfect for someone... but not me.
